doc: Which creature sounds like what (M3-AUD-14; game/audio/creature_audio.gd, docs/kb/tech/audio_runtime.md). creatures: an enemy's base id (enemies.json id, creatures.json key) -> events {idle, attack, hurt, death, move}, each an sfx row (sfx_creatures.json), plus pitch (a palette variant plays its parent's set at another pitch), family and variant_of (documentation). The string "silent" in place of an object means the enemy makes no creature sound; validate_data needs every enemies.json enemy to have one or the other. When: attack on the creature's own action (engine action_resolved); hurt on a landed damaging hit that leaves it standing (once per creature kind per action); death when a hit or its own turn's poison takes it to 0 HP (once, until it stands again); idle when the battle opens (the first voiced enemy) and when creatures join; move from its model's clips (clips: clip -> event, heard on the AnimationPlayer's animation_started under a node whose script class is a model_classes key, the value naming the property that holds its base id), or with its attack while no model is heard for it (move_on_action). delays_ms: after the moment (hurt and death sit just behind the hit and KO sounds); under_db: added to hurt and death so they layer under battle_sfx.json's hit and KO; idle_cooldown_ms: the shortest gap between one kind's idles; reduced_skip: events reduced audio leaves out. Listens only.
